name: Heinrich Dewus — death date and additional children (Milwaukee, 1936)
researcher_question: When did Heinrich Dewus of Milwaukee, Wisconsin (born about 1850 in Pommerania, Germany) die, and did he and his wife Augusta have children besides the four already in the tree?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 1, flags adds_son/adds_daughter/adds_death, confidence 3). RESOLVED 2026-08-04 as a TRUE MATCH: the GenealogyBank obituary (ark:/61903/1:1:Q5SZ-SH29) belongs to tree person 9VX4-1C3. The three new children (Walter, Ida, Eleanor) are independently corroborated by the 1900 US Census household and by each child's own later records naming Henry and Augusta as parents; the four other obituary children already match the tree. Findings retained as transcribed, with one correction — the death date is 23 Aug 1936 (the obituary's 28 Aug is the print date; a separate death notice and a one-year memorial both give 23 Aug). See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
